description: Defines the enum RateAppliesTo, which specifies the context in which a rate applies (e.g., to a loan). It includes methods for mapping integers to enum values, checking if the rate applies to a loan, and retrieving valid values.

classes.name: RateAppliesTo
classes.description: Enumeration representing different contexts where a rate can apply, such as to a loan or invalid entry.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the enum instance.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string associated with the enum instance.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to its corresponding RateAppliesTo enum value.

methods.name: isLoanRate
methods.description: Checks whether the RateAppliesTo instance represents a loan.

methods.name: validValues
methods.description: Returns an array of valid integer values for RateAppliesTo instances.
